svg.title: Four fixed grid bit canvases
svg.desc: The 64-bit-wide manuscript rows are shown as a full 32-row grid and three page-only groups. QR Code and Data Matrix decoders return no valid payload for any of the 16 declared transformations of each canvas.

g.text: Grid bits at manuscript row width
Eight fixed bits per token · eight tokens per row · no reflow
Positive QR and Data Matrix controls decoded. Blank space in each card is presentation only.
